title: Migrate procedure and Tactus persistence to GraphQLArtifactStore
description:
Purpose: Remove default AWS credential requirements from local procedure persistence.

Owned scope:
- Tactus procedure state, Lua state, checkpoints, dashboard projection, procedure code, and resume paths.
- Use the existing supported Plexus Tactus storage adapter interface without monkeypatching Tactus.

Acceptance:
- Procedure start, checkpoint, stop, and resume work through GraphQLArtifactStore.
- Existing object keys and dashboard readers remain compatible.
- Core-path tests make boto3.client for S3 raise and still pass.
- Missing or invalid transfers fail clearly without storage fallback.

Owned scope: supported Plexus Tactus storage adapter, ProcedureService state/checkpoint/code/dashboard projection persistence, and start/stop/resume paths plus their specifications. Dependency boundary: consumes landed Cognito dashboard-client support and GraphQLArtifactStore/ticket contract; does not alter Tactus internals, dashboard auth, ticket backend, or Wave 2 evaluation/optimizer consumers.
